effects.description:
(5 items) When you enter combat, |cffffff6|r% of the damage you take is transferred to your Companion instead. Reduce the damage your Companion takes by |cffffff0-16|r%. 

When your Companion dies in combat, they will automatically revive themselves after |cffffff12|r seconds. After reviving themselves, your Companion takes |cffffff100|r% less damage for |cffffff3|r seconds.
